```python
import selfies as sf
from rdkit import Chem
s='[C][N][C][Branch1][C][O][C][C][O][P][Ring1][#Branch1][=Branch1][C][=O][N][Branch1][Ring2][C][C][Cl][C][C][Cl]'

print('Decoded SMILES:',sm)
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(sm)
print('RDKit valid:',m is not None)
print('Canonical SMILES:',Chem.MolToSmiles(m) if m else 'INVALID')
```
